description: Electricity consumption benchmarks is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Industry, Science and Resources (DISR). Electricity consumption benchmarks – Survey responses matched with household consumption data for 25 households The AER is required to update electricity consumption benchmarks (available on www.energymadeeasy.gov.au) at least every three years. The benchmarks were initially developed in 2011. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Industry, Science and Resources (DISR). Its tags are benchmark, consumption, electricity, energy, hot water. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, DOCX, XLSX. The portal shows 2023-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
